AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVE
AbstractText.content: To investigate responsiveness, discrimination, and construct validity of a composite change index (CCI) for the assessment of single-joint involvement in inflammatory arthritis.

AbstractText.Label: METHODS
AbstractText.content: Evaluation of standardized response means (SRM), Guyatt effect size, and Spearman rank correlation coefficient in a randomized controlled trial investigating the effect of an intraarticular etanercept injection.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: The CCI showed a high SRM (1.68) and high Guyatt effect size (2.72). Both visual analog scale of pain and functionality had a moderate Guyatt effect size (2.06, 2.44) and high SRM (0.81, 0.97).

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: This study supports the use of the CCI as a single-joint assessment after single-joint intervention.
